notes: PROC FORMAT and PROC SURVEYMEANS statements are byte-identical to the source. Substituted a mock pufmeps.h209 dataset (20 rows, 5 strata x 2 PSUs) with the exact columns the script reads (varstr, varpsu, perwt18f, totexp18 and six expense-category variables) for the author's LIBNAME pufmeps 'C:\Data'; pointing at the restricted MEPS HC-209 file. Also dropped a trailing `*ods output domainratio=domain_ratio;` comment statement, which is valid SAS but not accepted by Jenner's PROC SURVEYMEANS statement parser (filed separately). The RATIO statement itself -- the point of the script -- runs unmodified and produces ratio estimates, SEs, and confidence limits per expense category.
